events.title: Update 0.18: Robbers now fight you with cards
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm the developer of An-pêng. The demo has been out for a week, and a lot has happened since. Today it jumps to version 0.18. The biggest change: when you run into a robber and choose "Fight", you now play out a card duel. Here's everything in this update. ⚠️ Read this first: saves Each run now has exactly one save. events.title: The demo is out! What world will you wake up to in Anping, Tainan?
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm the developer of An-pêng. The demo is out! This is An-pêng's first announcement, so here's a look at everything this demo version contains. After the air raid, everyone in Anping evacuated inland. You didn't. The next morning you wake up, still alive, but the fridge has no power and outside the window everything is chaos. You have exactly one job: live one more day. 👤 Who you are starts at the mirrorThe story begins in front of a bathroom mirror. Young, adult or old, male or fem
